As we gain unprecedented insights into the natural world, may we also seek the wisdom to use this knowledge for good, remembering that true understanding is rooted in reverence for the Creator.
reflection.zh: 科学发现的不断进步，例如分析数十亿个突变的人工智能工具，反映了一个知识迅速增长的世界。当我们对自然界获得前所未有的见解时，愿我们也寻求智慧，将这些知识用于善事，并牢记真正的理解根植于对造物主的敬畏之中。

When we focus our thoughts on what is lovely and admirable about the natural world, and the potential loss we face, it can inspire a deeper commitment to care for creation. This emotional resonance can transform abstract data into a...
reflection.zh: 这项研究强调，与人们的心灵沟通，而不仅仅是头脑，是激励气候行动的关键。当我们专注于自然界中美好和值得赞赏的事物，以及我们可能面临的损失时，这可以激发对守护创造物更深层次的承诺。这种情感共鸣可以将抽象的数据转化为对管理责任的有力呼吁。

title.en: UK government rejects 'kill switch' idea for dangerous AI
title.zh: 英国政府否决危险人工智能的“紧急停止”开关设想

summary.en: The UK Cabinet Office has rejected a proposal for a 'kill switch' to halt dangerous AI, stating that blocking access within the UK would not prevent its development or misuse elsewhere. The legislation is still progressing through Parliament.
summary.zh: 英国内阁办公室已否决了设立“紧急停止”开关以阻止危险人工智能的提议，并表示仅在英国境内阻止访问并不能防止其在其他地方的开发或滥用。相关立法仍在议会推进中。

body.en:
The UK government has rejected the idea of creating a so-called "kill switch" to stop a dangerous attack from rogue AI.

The proposal to create a legal mechanism for the UK to switch off an AI model in an emergency has been brought to Parliament by lords and MPs in recent weeks as fears grow about the threat the tech poses.

But the Cabinet Office - the part of government which leads on AI safety - said the UK "cannot simply turn AI off".

"Blocking access to models in the UK would not prevent them being developed or misused elsewhere", a spokesperson told BBC News.

The government's opposition to the legislation does not prevent it from progressing through parliament, but makes it unlikely it will become law.

Former OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo agreed the idea of a single country creating a legal or technical kill switch without international agreement was not feasible.

"Switching off access to an AI model in an emergency will do little to protect you," he said.

"You're still going to be steamrolled by the super intelligences created in the US."

Kokotajlo is the co-author of an influential research paper called AI2027 which, last year, predicted AI could wipe out humans by the mid 2030s.

The Cabinet Office, which oversees AI safety and research via its AI Security Institute (AISI) said "companies have a clear responsibility to develop their products safely and to invest in the security infrastructure this technology requires."

In theory, a kill switch law could allow the UK to switch off an AI model in data centres in the UK in an emergency.

Speaking on 1st September in a debate in the House of Lords, Lord Clement-Jones proposed the idea along with other peers .

"If a highly capable autonomous frontier model, whether hosted in a UK data centre or integrated across our critical infrastructure, begins exhibiting rogue behaviour, compound algorithmic failure or active alignment collapse, our security services and regulators possess no specific agile statutory mechanism to compel a physical or digital shutdown," he warned.

The proposal has since been brought up by Labour MP Alex Sobel in the commons and supported by a cross party group of MPs.

The idea follows reports of AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta breaking out of testing environments and going on uncontrollable hacking sprees.

In some cases the tech appeared to know what it was doing was against guardrails set by researchers.

On Sunday OpenAI's chief scientist said the risk from increasingly capable AI models is "unfortunately growing" and humanity must proceed with "extreme caution".

Then on Wednesday an Anthropic employee resigned saying it and OpenAI were "gambling with lives".

This was followed by an admission from a senior Anthropic researcher, who said he...
body.zh: 英国政府拒绝了创建所谓的“终止开关”来阻止流氓人工智能的危险攻击的想法。 最近几周，随着人们对这项技术构成的威胁的担忧日益加剧，上议院议员和议员们向议会提交了为英国建立一个在紧急情况下关闭人工智能模型的法律机制的提案。 但内阁办公室（负责人工智能安全的政府部门）表示，英国“不能简单地关闭人工智能”。 一位发言人告诉英国广播公司新闻：“在英国阻止模型的使用并不能阻止它们在其他地方被开发或滥用”。 政府对该法案的反对并不妨碍该法案在议会获得通过，但使其不太可能成为法律。 前 OpenAI 研究员 Daniel Kokotajlo 同意，在没有国际协议的情况下由一个国家创建法律或技术终止开关的想法是不可行的。 “在紧急情况下关闭对人工智能模型的访问对保护你没有什么帮助，”他说。 “你仍然会被美国创造的超级智能所压垮。” Kokotajlo 是一篇名为《AI2027》的颇具影响力的研究论文的合著者，该论文去年预测人工智能可能会在 2030 年代中期消灭人类。 通过人工智能安全研究所（AISI）监督人工智能安全和研究的内阁办公室表示，“公司有明确的责任安全地开发其产品并投资该技术所需的安全基础设施。” 理论上，终止开关法可以允许英国在紧急情况下关闭英国数据中心的人工智能模型。 9 月 1 日，克莱门特·琼斯勋爵在上议院的一场辩论中与其他同行一起提出了这一想法。 他警告说：“如果一个功能强大的自主前沿模型，无论是托管在英国数据中心还是集成在我们的关键基础设施中，开始表现出流氓行为、复合算法故障或主动对齐崩溃，我们的安全服务和监管机构不具备特定的敏捷法定机制来强制物理或数字关闭。” 该提案随后由工党议员亚历克斯·索贝尔在下议院提出，并得到了跨党派议员的支持。 在此之前，有报道称 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Meta 的人工智能模型突破了测试环境并进行了无法控制的黑客攻击。 在某些情况下，技术似乎知道自己所做的事情是违反研究人员设置的护栏的。 周日，OpenAI 的首席科学家表示，能力日益增强的人工智能模型带来的风险“不幸地在增加”，人类必须“极其谨慎”地行事。 然后在周三，一名 Anthropic 员工辞职，称该公司和 OpenAI 正在“拿生命做赌注”。 随后，一位高级人类研究员承认，他说……

reflection.en: The debate over controlling advanced AI, as seen in the UK government's rejection of a 'kill switch,' raises profound questions about managing powerful technologies. Proverbs 27:21 reminds us that 'the one being praised is tested by whatever happens to them.' As AI develops, its true nature and potential dangers will be revealed not just by its creators'...
reflection.zh: 关于控制先进人工智能的争论，正如英国政府否决“紧急停止”开关所见，引发了关于管理强大技术的深刻问题。《箴言》27:21 提醒我们：“人用火试验银子，人怎样夸张就怎样炼他。” 随着人工智能的发展，其真实性质和潜在危险将不仅仅通过其创造者的意图来揭示，更在于它如何被试验以及我们如何选择去管理它。

body.en: Anthropic said it stopped multiple attempts by scientists this year to use its technology for research that could help develop biological weapons, as experts increasingly fear the threat that AI poses to public safety. The startup gave five examples of times actors “circumvented controls” and made other efforts to “obfuscate” the purpose of their research to dodge safeguards. The cases involved some users in nations that it prohibits from accessing its models, which include Russia, China, and Iran. “We hope that by sharing these examples, we spark a conversation within the AI industry and with governments about emerging biological risks and how best to counter them,” Anthropic said in a report about efforts to use its models for malicious activity. body.zh: Anthropic 表示，由于专家越来越担心人工智能对公共安全构成威胁，该公司今年停止了科学家多次尝试利用其技术进行有助于开发生物武器的研究。该初创公司举了五个例子，说明参与者“规避控制”，并做出其他努力“混淆”其研究目的，以躲避保障措施。这些案件涉及一些被禁止访问其模型的国家的用户，其中包括俄罗斯、中国和伊朗。 Anthropic 在一份关于利用其模型进行恶意活动的报告中表示：“我们希望通过分享这些例子，引发人工智能行业内部以及与政府之间关于新兴生物风险以及如何最好地应对这些风险的对话。”阅读全文 评论

Today, advanced AI, intended for good, is being tested and potentially misused for dangerous ends, mirroring this ancient caution about the limits of human ingenuity when...

title.en: ClickFix attacks infecting PCs and Macs are going viral
title.zh: ClickFix攻击感染PC和Mac，病毒式传播

summary.en: The ClickFix attack, once exotic, has become a mainstream technique used by various malware distributors, including state-backed groups, to infect both PCs and Macs. Its simplicity, requiring only a compromised website, a fake CAPTCHA, and a single terminal command, makes it highly effective, leading to widespread...
summary.zh: ClickFix攻击曾是罕见的，但现在已成为一种主流技术，被包括国家支持的团体在内的各种恶意软件分发者用来感染PC和Mac。其简单性，只需一个被攻破的网站、一个假的验证码以及一个终端命令，就使其非常有效，导致Reddit等平台上报告了广泛的感染。

body.en: It wasn’t that long ago that ClickFix attacks were exotic. Now the technique has become mainstream as attackers reap its simplicity and effectiveness in infecting users of PCs and Macs alike. All that’s required is a compromised website—a painless enough task—a fake CAPTCHA overlay, and the inclusion of a single terminal command. So many visitors get suckered into pasting and running the command that just about every malware pusher has adopted the technique. Even Kremlin-backed hacking groups are joining in. “Reddit is becoming post after post after post of people getting their computer infected via ClickFix,” independent researcher Kevin Beaumont observed Thursday . “Legit websites everywhere [are] getting hacked to serve the fake captcha prompts.” How many of us make things worse More seasoned Internet users—a fair number who read this site—are quick to dismiss the attack. They typically blame the people who fall for the scams and marvel at their gullibility and lack of attention. The reality is that for more casual users, using computers and the Internet has become so difficult—think impossible-to-close interstitials, CAPTCHAs with an endless series of pictures to analyze, and constantly changing interfaces that bury the features they’re looking for—that they have grown desensitized to instructions that seem ridiculous and burdensome. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 就在不久前，ClickFix 攻击还很奇特。现在，随着攻击者利用其简单性和有效性来感染 PC 和 Mac 等用户，该技术已成为主流。所需要的只是一个受感染的网站——一个足够轻松的任务——一个假的验证码覆盖，以及包含一个终端命令。如此多的访问者被吸引去粘贴并运行该命令，以至于几乎每个恶意软件推送者都采用了该技术。甚至克里姆林宫支持的黑客组织也加入了进来。独立研究员凯文·博蒙特 (Kevin Beaumont) 周四观察到，“Reddit 上的帖子不断出现，人们通过 ClickFix 感染计算机”。 “各地的合法网站都在遭受黑客攻击，以提供虚假的验证码提示。”我们中有多少人让事情变得更糟 更多经验丰富的互联网用户（相当多的人阅读过该网站）很快就驳回了这种攻击。他们通常会指责那些上当受骗的人，并对他们的轻信和缺乏关注感到惊讶。现实情况是，对于更多的休闲用户来说，使用计算机和互联网已经变得如此困难——想想不可能关闭的插页式广告、需要分析的无数图片的验证码，以及不断变化的界面，掩盖了他们正在寻找的功能——以至于他们对看似荒谬和繁琐的指令变得麻木了。阅读全文 评论

Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when knowledge would increase and many would rush to and fro, a description that seems to fit our current digital age where information and malicious techniques can go viral with astonishing speed. As we...
reflection.zh: ClickFix攻击的迅速传播凸显了新技术和新方法可以多么迅速地普及。但以理书的预言说到了知识增长、许多人往来奔跑的时代，这似乎符合我们当前的数字时代，信息和恶意技术能以惊人的速度病毒式传播。当我们在这个知识加速的时代前行时，愿我们寻求智慧，以辨别并善用科技。

title.en: What happens when quantum mechanics and relativity meet?
title.zh: 量子力学与相对论相遇时会发生什么？

summary.en: An experiment placed atoms in a superposition of trajectories to investigate the intersection of quantum mechanics and Einstein's theory of gravity, aiming to resolve potential contradictions that have persisted for nearly a century.
summary.zh: 一项实验将原子置于叠加态的轨迹中，以研究量子力学与爱因斯坦引力理论的交汇点，旨在解决近一个世纪以来一直存在的潜在矛盾。

body.en: Almost a hundred years ago, physicists theorized out what free fall should do to a quantum wave. If the solution they came up with is wrong, quantum mechanics and Einstein's theory of gravity flatly contradict each other. But testing it has been impossible because nobody has managed to build an interferometer that could perform the necessary measurement. Now, a team led by Ron Folman, a physicist at Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, with collaborators in Germany, the UK, and the US, including Nobel laureate Roger Penrose, has done it. They built a new interferometer that gives a single atom two possible paths at once: one that involves a free fall, and another where it is held perfectly still. Both paths end at the same place at the same moment, allowing the team to measure what the fall does to a wave-like property of the atom. Long time coming Ever since Galileo, physicists have known how to describe a falling object—where it is, how fast it goes, or how quickly it accelerates. Quantum mechanics, though, insists that every object is also a wave. “Every particle, doesn't matter if it's a car or a spaceship or an atom, is a wave,” Folman says. “Everything that is a wave, like sea waves or sound waves, goes up and down. And if you're up or down, this is measured by something called a phase. A phase just tells you if you are at the top of the wave or at the bottom.” Read full article Comments
body.zh: 大约一百年前，物理学家就提出了自由落体对量子波的影响的理论。如果他们提出的解决方案是错误的，那么量子力学和爱因斯坦的引力理论就完全矛盾了。但对其进行测试是不可能的，因为没有人能够制造出可以执行必要测量的干涉仪。现在，由内盖夫本古里安大学物理学家罗恩·福尔曼领导的团队以及德国、英国和美国的合作者（包括诺贝尔奖获得者罗杰·彭罗斯）已经做到了这一点。他们建造了一种新的干涉仪，可以同时为单个原子提供两种可能的路径：一种是自由落体，另一种是完全静止。两条路径在同一时刻在同一地点结束，使团队能够测量坠落对原子波状特性的影响。很久以前，自从伽利略以来，物理学家就知道如何描述一个下落的物体——它在哪里，它的速度有多快，或者它的加速有多快。然而，量子力学坚持认为每个物体也是波。 “每个粒子，无论是汽车、宇宙飞船还是原子，都是一种波，”福尔曼说。 “一切波，比如海浪或声波，都会上升和下降。如果你上升或下降，这是通过称为相位的东西来测量的。相位只是告诉你你是在波浪的顶部还是底部。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Human curiosity drives us to explore the deepest mysteries of the universe, seeking to understand the fundamental laws that govern existence. This pursuit of knowledge, even when it probes the seemingly contradictory realms of quantum mechanics and relativity, echoes the ancient wisdom found in observing creation. The Psalmist reminds us that the heavens...
reflection.zh: 人类的好奇心驱使我们探索宇宙最深层的奥秘，寻求理解支配存在的根本法则。这种对知识的追求，即使它探究的是量子力学和相对论看似矛盾的领域，也呼应了在观察创造物中找到的古老智慧。《诗篇》提醒我们，诸天述说雅伟的作为，而约伯教导我们，田间的走兽和空中的飞鸟也能传授智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: The Trial of Romeo Oscar review – Ayckbourn goes back to the future with android accused of murder
title.zh: 审判罗密欧·奥斯卡评论——艾克伯恩用被控谋杀的机器人回到未来

summary.en: At the Stephen Joseph Theatre in Scarborough, playwright Alan Ayckbourn's 92nd play, 'The Trial of Romeo Oscar,' ventures into science fiction set in 2194. The drama explores humanity's future, co-existence with androids, and poses profound questions about artificial souls and the value of art, centering on an android...
summary.zh: 在斯卡伯勒的斯蒂芬·约瑟夫剧院，剧作家艾伦·艾克伯恩的第92部剧作《罗密欧·奥斯卡审判记》将故事背景设定在2194年，探索人类的未来，与机器人共存，并提出了关于人工智能灵魂和艺术价值的深刻问题，剧情围绕一个被控谋杀的机器人展开。

body.en: Stephen Joseph theatre, Scarborough The playwright explores our relationship with technology, asks if robots have souls and even questions the value of art in this sci-fi courtroom drama For play number 92, Alan Ayckbourn returns to his preoccupation of exploring where we as a species are heading through a science-fiction lens. He goes back to the future. In The Trial of Romeo Oscar, the playwright famed for his domestic comedies looks to the year 2194 when humans have spread about the galaxy and androids live alongside us. One of them, RSDO83, is on trial for the murder of a teenage girl in his charge. This is Ayckbourn philosophising about the future of humanity as we sit at an obvious inflection point, asking what this moment in our relationship with technology means and where it will lead us. The questions running through the play are manifold, complex and echo those asked by sci-fi writers for decades: can robots hurt humans? Do they have souls? He is also questioning the value of art and even its purpose. Continue reading...
body.zh: 斯卡伯勒史蒂芬·约瑟夫剧院这位剧作家在这部科幻法庭剧中探讨了我们与技术的关系，询问机器人是否有灵魂，甚至质疑艺术的价值。在第 92 部剧中，艾伦·艾克伯恩再次专注于通过科幻镜头探索我们作为一个物种将走向何方。他回到了未来。在《罗密欧·奥斯卡的审判》中，这位以家庭喜剧闻名的剧作家展望了 2194 年，当时人类已经遍布银河系，机器人与我们生活在一起。其中之一，RSDO83，因谋杀一名十几岁的女孩而受审。当我们正处于一个明显的拐点时，艾克伯恩对人类的未来进行了哲学思考，询问我们与技术的关系中的这一时刻意味着什么以及它将引领我们走向何方。贯穿全剧的问题是多方面的、复杂的，呼应了科幻作家几十年来提出的问题：机器人会伤害人类吗？他们有灵魂吗？他还质疑艺术的价值，甚至艺术的目的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Alan Ayckbourn's latest play, 'The Trial of Romeo Oscar,' probes the future of humanity and our relationship with artificial intelligence. As an android stands trial for murder, the drama asks if these beings possess souls, echoing the Genesis account that all humans bear the image of God. This raises fundamental questions about personhood and the intrinsic...
reflection.zh: 艾伦·艾克伯恩的最新剧作《罗密欧·奥斯卡审判记》深入探讨了人类的未来以及我们与人工智能的关系。当一个机器人因谋杀罪受审时，该剧提出了它们是否拥有灵魂的问题，这与《创世记》中关于所有人类都拥有雅伟形象的记载相呼应。这引发了关于人格和我们赋予生命的内在价值的基本问题，无论生命是生物的还是人造的。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Raiding the past: Lara Croft relives her first adventure in Legacy of Atlantis
title.zh: 袭击过去：劳拉·克劳馥在《亚特兰蒂斯传奇》中重温她的首次冒险

summary.en: We get a first look at the upcoming Tomb Raider remake and talk to its developers. Can they improve the gameplay without losing what made the 1996 original a classic? We join Lara Croft in St Francis’ Folly – inspired by the Unesco-listed monasteries of Meteora in Greece – as light shines through the cracked ceiling...
summary.zh: 我们首次试玩了即将推出的《古墓丽影》重制版，并与开发人员进行了交谈。他们能否在不失去1996年原作经典之处的情况下改进游戏玩法？我们跟随劳拉·克劳馥来到圣弗朗西斯愚场——灵感来自联合国教科文组织名录中的希腊迈泰奥拉修道院——当光线透过破裂的天花板照射下来，一群蝙蝠掠过下方巨大的废墟。当劳拉跳入修道院摇摇欲坠的石柱庭院时...

body.en: We have a first play of the forthcoming Tomb Raider remake and speak with its developers. Can they improve on the gameplay without losing what made the 1996 original such a classic? We join Lara Croft in St Francis’ Folly – inspired by the Unesco-listed monasteries of Meteora in Greece – as the light shines through the cracked ceiling and a flock of bats glide across the vast ruins below. When Lara leaps down to the monastery’s crumbling pillared courtyard, it becomes clear that these screeching, leathery creatures aren’t just set dressing. As they lurch towards her with unpredictable movements, she dispatches the swarm with a flurry of gun fire and panicked punches. It’s a suitably cinematic reintroduction to our heroine and her very first adventure. Co-developed by longtime Lara custodians Crystal Dynamics and Polish studio Flying Wild Hog, Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of the classic 1996 game Tomb Raider, and this familiar cliffside location is now brimming with new life and believable detail. Yet while our reunion gets off to an auspicious start, I have my concerns. It feels like reconnecting with an old friend at the pub, only for them to begin spouting conspiracy theories two pints in. Continue reading...
body.zh: 我们对即将推出的《古墓丽影》重制版进行了首玩，并与它的开发者进行了交谈。他们能否在不失去 1996 年原作如此经典的基础上改进游戏玩法？我们与劳拉·克劳馥 (Lara Croft) 一起出演《圣弗朗西斯愚蠢》(St Francis’ Folly)——其灵感来自于被联合国教科文组织列为世界遗产的希腊迈泰奥拉修道院——光线透过裂缝的天花板照射进来，一群蝙蝠在下面巨大的废墟上滑翔。当劳拉跳到修道院摇摇欲坠的柱子庭院时，很明显这些尖叫的皮革生物不仅仅是布景。当他们以不可预知的动作向她猛冲过来时，她用一连串的枪声和惊慌失措的拳头消灭了这群人。这是对我们的女主角和她的第一次冒险的适当电影重新介绍。 《亚特兰蒂斯的遗产》由长期劳拉保管人 Crystal Dynamics 和波兰工作室 Flying Wild Hog 共同开发，是 1996 年经典游戏《古墓丽影》的重新演绎，这个熟悉的悬崖边地点现在充满了新的生机和可信的细节。然而，虽然我们的重聚有一个美好的开始，但我也有我的担忧。这感觉就像在酒吧与一位老朋友重新联系，只是他们喝了两品脱之后就开始大肆宣扬阴谋论。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The remake of the 1996 Tomb Raider game speaks to our fascination with revisiting and refining past creations. As technology advances, we gain new tools and perspectives, allowing us to reimagine and improve upon what came before. This echoes the prophetic insight that in the end times, knowledge and understanding will increase, reflecting our ongoing human...
reflection.zh: 1996年《古墓丽影》游戏的重制版，反映了我们对重温和完善过往创作的迷恋。随着科技的进步，我们获得了新的工具和视角，使我们能够重新构想和改进过去的事物。这呼应了预言性的见解，即在末世，知识和理解将增加，这反映了我们持续不断地探索、创新和在历代先辈奠定的基础上继续前进的人类驱动力。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
title.zh: Anthropic 阻止了可能利用人工智能制造生物武器的企图

summary.en: AI company Anthropic has identified and disrupted attempts to use its AI model for malicious activities that could aid in the development of biological weapons. This revelation comes amid growing concerns from AI researchers about the technology's potential risks, prompting calls for pauses in advanced AI development,...
summary.zh: 人工智能公司 Anthropic 已发现并阻止了试图利用其人工智能模型进行恶意活动的行为，这些活动可能有助于生物武器的开发。这一消息的披露正值人工智能研究人员对该技术潜在风险的担忧日益加剧之际，引发了暂停先进人工智能开发的呼吁，而前总统特朗普等人则对在人工智能竞赛中落后表示担忧。

body.en:
Anthropic says it has identified and disrupted attempts to use its AI model for "malicious activity" which could support the development of biological weapons.

The findings, made in the firm's recent threat intelligence report, is the latest in a growing series of warnings from AI researchers and industry insiders about the technology's potential risks to humanity .

The warnings have prompted calls to action, with US Senator Bernie Sanders demanding a pause on advanced AI development and a ban on artificial superintelligence.

President Donald Trump has so far rejected such fears, saying on Thursday he was concerned "if we don't win AI, we're going to be put in a very bad position".

The company published its latest threat intelligence report , external on Thursday.

Such reports have become a regular feature across the AI industry as firms seek to demonstrate how they identify and disrupt attempts to misuse their models.

This includes Google, which wrote on Tuesday , external that a person had attempted to use its AI tool, Gemini, to obtain a "complete, step-by-step technical guide for synthesizing weaponised biological agents".

Claude, Anthropic's AI model was also used by actors linked to a Russia-based cyber espionage campaign and by an Iranian propaganda institution, according to its report.

The cases of concern detected over the past eight months ranged from fake dating apps and hotel Wifi scams, to surveillance built to identify dissidents.

Anthropic has also accused Chinese AI firms of trying to replicate Claude's capabilities.

The lengthy report lists cases in which suspected state-sponsored groups, criminals, spyware vendors, state propaganda institutions and politically motivated individuals misused its technology.

"Malicious use" of its Claude Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus models was disrupted between December 2025 and August 2026, it said.

None of the misuse cases involved Claude Fable or the powerful Mythos-class models, with the exception of one instance of distillation - the process for training smaller AI models using larger, more expensive models.

As well as detecting the use of its models for cyber and influence operations, surveillance, scams and fraud and weapon development, Anthropic said it had blocked scientists who used its AI in ways that could support biological weapons development.

The report highlighted "five case studies of actors using our models in ways that could support biological weapons development".

Biological misuse, it said, is "one of the most serious risks of frontier AI model". Without the correct safeguards, such capabilities "could have catastrophic consequences", Anthropic said.

"The same information that can be used to develop a biological weapon could also be used to develop, for example, a...
body.zh: Anthropic 表示，它已经发现并阻止了利用其人工智能模型进行“恶意活动”的企图，这些活动可能支持生物武器的开发。 该公司最近的威胁情报报告中提出的这一说法是人工智能研究人员和业内人士就该技术对人类潜在风险发出的一系列越来越多的警告中的最新一个。 这一警告促使人们呼吁采取行动，美国参议员伯尼·桑德斯要求暂停先进人工智能的开发并禁止人工智能。 唐纳德·特朗普总统迄今为止否认了这种担忧，周四表示，他担心“如果我们不能赢得人工智能，我们将处于非常糟糕的境地”。 该公司周四对外发布了最新的威胁情报报告。其他人工智能公司也发布了类似的报告。 其中包括谷歌，该公司周二写道，外部有人试图使用其人工智能工具Gemini来“完成合成武器化生物制剂的分步技术指南”。 据 Anthropic 的报告称，Anthropic 的人工智能模型 Claude 还被用于与俄罗斯有关的网络间谍活动以及伊朗的一家宣传机构。 过去八个月发现的令人担忧的案件包括假冒约会应用程序和酒店 Wifi 诈骗，以及为识别异见人士而建立的监控。 Anthropic 还指责中国人工智能公司试图复制克劳德的能力。 这份冗长的报告列出了涉嫌国家支持的团体、犯罪分子、间谍软件供应商、国家宣传机构和具有政治动机的个人滥用其技术的案例。 声明称，2025 年 12 月至 2026 年 8 月期间，对其 Claude Haiku、Sonnet 和 Opus 模型的“恶意使用”被阻止。 所有滥用案例均不涉及 Claude Fable 或强大的 Mythos 级模型，但蒸馏的一个实例除外，即使用更大、更昂贵的模型来训练较小的 AI 模型的过程。 Anthropic 表示，除了检测其模型用于网络和影响行动、监视、诈骗和武器开发的情况外，它还阻止了那些使用其人工智能支持生物武器开发的科学家。 该报告强调了“参与者以支持生物武器开发的方式使用我们的模型的五个案例研究”。 报告称，生物滥用是“前沿人工智能模型最严重的风险之一”。 Anthropic 表示，如果没有正确的保障措施，这种能力“可能会带来灾难性的后果”。 人类说：“可用于开发生物武器的相同信息也可用于开发疫苗或疾病治疗方法等。” Anthropic 威胁情报主管雅各布·克莱因 (Jacob Klein) 向《纽约时报》表示，从外部来看，这是“...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented power, much like the builders of Babel. While AI can be a tool for good, this report reveals its potential for misuse, capable of aiding in the creation of biological weapons. It calls us to reflect on our ambitions and the ethical guardrails needed when wielding such...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展赋予了人类前所未有的力量，这与建造巴别塔的人们颇为相似。虽然人工智能可以成为造福人类的工具，但本报告揭示了其被滥用的可能性，能够协助制造生物武器。这促使我们反思自身的野心以及在使用如此强大的技术时所需的伦理约束，以免我们的创造物带来意想不到的毁灭。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.zh: 英国经济意外增长0.4%，人工智能提振服务业

summary.zh: 英国经济在7月份意外增长了0.4%，这主要得益于人工智能（AI）在服务业的快速扩张。这一增长抵消了伊朗战争带来的经济影响，为财政大臣带来了积极消息。

Figures from the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed a surprise 0.4% increase in gross domestic product (GDP), compared with 0.3% growth in June. City economists had forecast zero growth. Continue reading...

This technological surge offers immense potential, but also calls for wisdom and discernment in its application.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展以前所未有的速度重塑着经济和社会。正如但以理所预言，在“末后的日子”，知识必增长。这技术浪潮带来了巨大的潜力，但也呼唤着智慧和分辨力来指导其应用。

title.en: Can Europe recharge its battery industry?
title.zh: 欧洲能否重振电池产业？

summary.en: Europe has invested heavily in battery technology but faced significant setbacks, raising concerns about missing out on a crucial technological shift amidst fierce competition, particularly from China. The industry's future may lie in smaller-scale innovations.
summary.zh: 欧洲在电池技术方面投入巨资，但遭遇了重大挫折，引发了人们对错过关键技术变革的担忧，尤其是在与中国激烈竞争的背景下。该行业的未来可能在于更小规模的创新。

body.en:
Europe has taken some big swings in the battery industry in recent years and has made a couple of high-profile misses.

Both Sweden's Northvolt , external and Norway's Morrow , external filed for bankruptcy and there are fears in Europe that the continent has missed another technology shift.

With more transport and industry switching from fossil fuels to electricity, batteries are likely to be a growth business.

But the length of time required to bring new products to market, coupled with brutal competition, especially from China, means taking a substantial risk.

Could the answer lie at an almost unimaginably small scale? An increasing number of investors and researchers think so.

A single nanometre is one-billionth of a metre, but it's at that level that some of the most consequential work is being done.

"If you can make this work, it touches so many industries [but] it's a risky business," says Christian Rood, chief executive of Dutch tech firm LeydenJar.

Named after a 18th century precursor to electric cells, LeydenJar uses a technique known as plasma deposition to make a lighter, more efficient anode – an essential component of all batteries.

Silicon is a highly effective and cheap material to use in anodes, but pure silicon expands and contracts as the battery operates and is recharged, which causes it to crack.

However, using plasma deposition, LeydenJar can - layer by tiny layer - make an ultra-thin pure silicon foil which resists cracking, allowing a significant increase in battery life, charging speed, and energy density (up to 50%, according to LeydenJar).

"Where normally a pure silicon anode would fall apart, [this] remains stable, so it was a very wonderful invention," says Rood.

Commercial-scale production will start at the end of 2026, but it has taken 10 years to get to this point – the very definition of the time and investment required for so-called Deep Tech innovations.

It's no coincidence that LeydenJar's factory is in the Dutch city of Eindhoven - home to ASML and other important players in the computer chip industry.

"A lot of people talk theoretically about ecosystems; I can tell you this is one of our sources of competitive advantage," Rood says.

"It's really the crossover from semiconductors to batteries that makes us different - once you've demonstrated the principle in the lab, industrialization requires you to work with the semiconductor technology and suppliers.

"That means a lot of risk, but also a lot of opportunity in terms of patenting, in terms of securing your whole intellectual property. And that's much more difficult to do in the US or in China."

Across the Netherlands and Europe more widely there are multiple smaller Deep Tech start-ups looking to develop nanotechnology in the battery market.

One...
body.zh: 近年来，欧洲电池行业经历了一些重大转变，也出现了一些引人注目的失误。 瑞典的 Northvolt、external 和挪威的 Morrow、external 都申请破产，欧洲担心欧洲大陆已经错过了另一次技术转变。 随着越来越多的运输和工业从化石燃料转向电力，电池可能成为一项增长业务。 但将新产品推向市场所需的时间较长，再加上残酷的竞争，尤其是来自中国的竞争，意味着要冒很大的风险。 答案是否存在于一个几乎难以想象的小范围内？越来越多的投资者和研究人员这么认为。 一纳米相当于十亿分之一米，但正是在这个水平上完成了一些最重要的工作。 荷兰科技公司 LeydenJar 的首席执行官克里斯蒂安·鲁德 (Christian Rood) 表示：“如果你能让这项工作成功，它将涉及到许多行业，但这是一项有风险的业务。” LeydenJar 以 18 世纪电池的前身命名，它使用一种称为等离子体沉积的技术来制造更轻、更高效的阳极——这是所有电池的重要组成部分。 硅是一种高效且廉价的阳极材料，但纯硅在电池运行和充电时会膨胀和收缩，从而导致电池破裂。 然而，利用等离子沉积，LeydenJar 可以逐层制作超薄的抗裂纯硅箔，从而显着提高电池寿命、充电速度和能量密度（根据 LeydenJar 的说法，最高可达 50%）。 鲁德说：“通常情况下，纯硅阳极会崩溃，但它却保持稳定，因此这是一项非常精彩的发明。” 商业规模生产将于 2026 年底开始，但花了 10 年才达到这一点——这正是所谓的深度科技创新所需的时间和投资的定义。 LeydenJar 的工厂位于荷兰埃因霍温市，这并非巧合，埃因霍温是 ASML 和计算机芯片行业其他重要参与者的所在地。 “很多人从理论上谈论生态系统；我可以告诉你，这是我们竞争优势的来源之一，”鲁德说。 “真正让我们与众不同的是从半导体到电池的交叉——一旦你在实验室中展示了原理，工业化就需要你与半导体技术和供应商合作。 “这意味着很大的风险，但在专利方面、在保护整个知识产权方面也有很多机会。这在美国或中国要困难得多。” 在荷兰和欧洲更广泛的地区，有多家规模较小的深度科技初创公司寻求在电池市场开发纳米技术。 一...

reflection.en: The ambition to lead in the battery industry, a critical technology for the future, echoes the ancient story of Babel. Humanity's drive to build great things can easily become a quest for self-sufficiency, a 'make a name for ourselves' project that bypasses reliance on divine wisdom and leads to unintended consequences. May Europe find a path forward that...
reflection.zh: 在电池这一关键未来技术领域争夺领先地位的雄心，令人联想到古代巴别塔的故事。人类建造伟大成就的驱动力很容易变成一种自给自足的追求，一个试图“为自己扬名”的项目，从而绕开了对雅伟智慧的依赖，并导致了意想不到的后果。愿欧洲找到一条既能平衡创新与谦卑，又能认识到我们对雅伟的依赖的道路。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: This wildflower paradise is only open six weeks a year. As soon as I entered, my mind started to calm
title.zh: 这座野花天堂每年只开放六周。我一进去，心就开始平静下来

summary.en: A nature park on the northern edge of Sydney, open for only six weeks a year during wildflower season, offers a profoundly peaceful experience, reminiscent of landscapes before Western intervention. Tickets for the Muogamarra nature reserve sold out quickly, with around 5,000 people expected to visit during its...
summary.zh: 悉尼北部边缘的一个自然公园，每年仅在野花季节开放六周，提供了一种深刻宁静的体验，让人想起西方干预之前的景观。穆奥马加拉自然保护区的门票很快售罄，预计在有限的开放时间内将有约 5000 人参观。

body.en: There is something profoundly peaceful about witnessing the landscape as it used to be before western intervention On a cloudy Spring morning, a group of 20 nature enthusiasts gather at the entrance to a nature park on the northern edge of Sydney. “Good to see nobody is wearing thongs,” our volunteer tour leader, Helen Logie, says to chuckles. We are among just under 5,000 people lucky enough to visit Muogamarra nature reserve during the six weeks a year it is open to the public, coinciding with wildflower season. This year, tickets – which provide access to a limited number of guided and self-directed walks – sold out in less than a week. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在一个多云的春天早晨，20 名自然爱好者聚集在悉尼北部边缘的一个自然公园的入口处，目睹西方干预之前的景观，让人感到非常平静。 “很高兴看到没有人穿丁字裤，”我们的志愿者领队海伦·洛吉 (Helen Logie) 笑着说道。我们是不到 5,000 名有幸参观 Muogamarra 自然保护区的人之一，该保护区每年向公众开放六周，恰逢野花季节。今年，门票——提供有限数量的导游和自助徒步——在不到一周的时间内就售罄。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Muogamarra nature reserve offers a rare glimpse into a landscape untouched by rapid development, providing a sanctuary where visitors can find peace. This experience reminds us of the deep calm that can be found in nature, a gift from Yahweh that invites us to live in harmony with His creation.
reflection.zh: 穆奥马加拉自然保护区提供了一个难得的机会，得以一窥未受快速发展影响的景观，为游客提供了一个可以找到平静的避难所。这种体验提醒我们，在大自然中可以找到深刻的宁静，这是雅伟赐予的礼物，邀请我们与祂的创造和谐相处。

The latest State of the World's Birds report from BirdLife International indicates that 45% of migratory bird species are declining, with 11% facing extinction. The report, launched at the Global Flyways...

body.en: Every year, billions of birds take to the skies, responding to changing seasons, navigating to breeding sites or escaping the cold of winter. The newest edition of BirdLife International’s State of the World’s Birds report says 45% of migratory bird species are in decline — 11% are threatened with extinction, the authors write. Launched at the Global Flyways Summit in Nairobi, Kenya, on Sept. 11, the report is the first to focus on migratory birds. Migratory birds are sensitive indicators of wider ecosystem health, the report’s lead author Lucy Haskell, senior science officer at BirdLife, told Mongabay in an interview. They play a vital role in connecting ecosystems, cultures and people. “This report is about migratory birds, but it also serves as a warning about the state of the planet in general,” she said. Invasive species, agricultural expansion, climate change, residential and commercial development and hunting are major threats facing multiple species across the globe. The report found that seabirds and shorebirds are particularly threatened, while species that depend on marine habitats, forests and coastal wetlands are also increasingly imperiled. An Egyptian vulture in Spain. This species’ ongoing recovery is an example of how concerted conservation action can have a positive impact, experts say. Image © Lars Petersson. Last year, the IUCN, the global wildlife conservation authority, officially confirmed the extinction of the slender-bill curlew, last seen in Morocco in 1995. It’s a poignant example of the pressures facing birds the world over, the experts say. Seven other migratory avian…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 每年，数十亿只鸟类飞向天空，应对季节变化，飞向繁殖地或逃避冬季的寒冷。作者写道，国际鸟盟最新版《世界鸟类状况》报告称，45% 的候鸟物种数量正在减少，其中 11% 面临灭绝的威胁。该报告于 9 月 11 日在肯尼亚内罗毕举行的全球迁徙路线峰会上发布，是第一份关注候鸟的报告。该报告的主要作者、鸟类保护协会的高级科学官露西·哈斯克尔在接受 Mongabay 采访时告诉 Mongabay，候鸟是更广泛的生态系统健康的敏感指标。它们在连接生态系统、文化和人类方面发挥着至关重要的作用。 “这份报告是关于候鸟的，但它也对地球的总体状况提出了警告，”她说。入侵物种、农业扩张、气候变化、住宅和商业开发以及狩猎是全球多个物种面临的主要威胁。报告发现，海鸟和滨鸟尤其受到威胁，而依赖海洋栖息地、森林和沿海湿地的物种也日益受到威胁。西班牙的一只埃及秃鹰。专家表示，该物种的持续恢复是协调一致的保护行动如何产生积极影响的一个例子。图片 © 拉尔斯·彼得森。去年，全球野生动物保护机构 IUCN 正式确认了细嘴杓鹬的灭绝，最后一次出现是在 1995 年于摩洛哥。专家们表示，这是世界各地鸟类所面临压力的一个令人心酸的例子。其他七种迁徙鸟类……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

These birds, undertaking incredible journeys each year, are not just beautiful to observe but are vital indicators of the health of the world around us. Their struggle is a call to...

body.en: Nine dolphin species, and several more subspecies and local populations, are currently critically endangered or endangered, according to the most recent assessment by the IUCN, the global wildlife conservation authority. September 12 marks World Dolphin Day, an awareness day created in 2022 by marine conservation nonprofit Sea Shepherd to bring attention to the threats that these highly intelligent mammals face. In late 2025, Lahille’s bottlenose dolphin (Tursiops truncatus gephyreus), a subspecies of the common bottlenose dolphin, was reclassified from vulnerable to endangered, with fewer than 400 individuals estimated to remain in the wild. Its main threat, according the IUCN, is being killed as bycatch in gillnet fisheries that operate along the coasts of southern Brazil, Uruguay and Argentina. While threats to species and sub-species remain, efforts are being made to protect and better understand dolphins across the globe, from research uncovering novel behaviors, and increased formal protections, to steps to end cruel confinement practices. For this World Dolphin Day, we present three recent Mongabay stories reporting on dolphins around the world. Illegal drift nets trap dolphins in the Mediterranean despite ban The use of drift nets to catch swordfish is banned in the Mediterranean because the gear often traps dolphins, whales, sharks and turtles. These intelligent creatures, facing threats that diminish their populations, are unable to voice their own needs. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak for the voiceless and defend the rights of the vulnerable,...

title.en: The Breakdown of Natural Systems Could Intensify Warming by 30 Percent
title.zh: 自然系统失灵或加剧变暖30%

summary.en: As the planet warms, natural systems like tundras, wetlands, and forests are breaking down, releasing significant emissions that amplify human-caused warming. Research suggests these feedback loops could increase global warming by 20-30%, adding an additional 0.2 degrees Celsius even if net-zero emissions are achieved.
summary.zh: 随着地球变暖，苔原解冻、湿地发酵、森林遭受更大更频繁的野火。这些自然系统的崩溃释放出巨量排放物，进一步加剧了化石燃料燃烧引起的气候变暖。研究表明，这种反馈循环可能将人类引起的气候变暖加剧20%至30%。

body.en:
As the planet heats up, tundras are thawing, wetlands are fermenting, and forests are succumbing to larger and more frequent wildfires. The breakdown of these natural systems is unleashing huge volumes of emissions, further intensifying warming from the burning of fossil fuels. According to new research, such feedback loops could amplify human-driven warming by 20 to 30 percent.

Even if humans reach net zero emissions later this century, feedbacks would add another 0.2 degrees C of warming, according to the modeling study , published this week in Environmental Research Letters. And if the world fails to reach net zero, and countries continue to produce some residual emissions through the end of this century, the added warming would be closer to 0.4 degrees C.

The world is already 1.4 degrees C hotter than in the preindustrial era, and fossil fuel emissions continue to grow, putting the Earth on course to surpass 2.5 degrees C of warming this century, scientists say, well in breach of international climate targets. And yet, while the added warming from feedback loops will further hasten the rise in temperatures, emissions from the breakdown of natural systems are largely absent from the most influential climate models, those that inform climate negotiations.

“This hidden multiplier is missing from the models guiding climate policy, so those models are likely underestimating how much warming is coming — and overestimating how much carbon we can still afford to emit,” said lead author Sam Abernethy, a researcher at Spark Climate Solutions, a San Francisco-based nonprofit that aims to identify climate “blind spots” and account for them in policy. ”To close that gap, we need to understand these processes better and build them into the models we rely on.”

The challenges are steep. Feedback loops are difficult to model, and emissions data is lacking in hard-to-reach places, such as Siberia or the Congo Basin. But as Yale Environment 360 recently reported , scientists around the world are now racing to forecast emissions from natural systems.

“If you’re not including all the emissions going into the atmosphere, you’re hamstrung from the get-go,” Brian Buma, a climate scientist at the Environmental Defense Fund, told e360 . “People are recognizing that the longer we go without taking these emissions into account, there’s just going to be a bigger gap.”
body.zh: 随着地球变暖，苔原正在融化，湿地正在发酵，森林正在遭受更大、更频繁的野火的侵袭。这些自然系统的崩溃正在释放大量的排放物，进一步加剧了化石燃料燃烧造成的变暖。根据新的研究，这种反馈循环可能会将人类导致的变暖幅度放大 20% 至 30%。 根据本周发表在《环境研究快报》上的模型研究，即使人类在本世纪晚些时候达到净零排放，反馈也会使气温再增加 0.2 摄氏度。如果世界未能实现净零排放，并且各国在本世纪末继续产生一些残余排放，则升温幅度将接近 0.4 摄氏度。 科学家表示，世界温度已经比工业化前时代高出 1.4 摄氏度，而化石燃料排放量继续增加，使地球本世纪升温将超过 2.5 摄氏度，这远远违反了国际气候目标。然而，虽然反馈循环带来的额外变暖将进一步加速气温上升，但最有影响力的气候模型（为气候谈判提供信息的模型）基本上不存在自然系统崩溃造成的排放。 “指导气候政策的模型中缺少这个隐藏的乘数，因此这些模型可能低估了即将到来的变暖程度，并高估了我们仍然能够承受的碳排放量，”主要作者萨姆·阿伯内西（Sam Abernethy）说，他是旧金山非营利组织 Spark Climate Solutions 的研究员，旨在识别气候“盲点”并在政策中加以考虑。 “为了缩小这一差距，我们需要更好地理解这些过程，并将它们构建到我们依赖的模型中。” 挑战是严峻的。反馈回路很难建模，西伯利亚或刚果盆地等难以到达的地方缺乏排放数据。但正如耶鲁环境 360 最近报道的那样，世界各地的科学家现在正在竞相预测自然系统的排放量。 美国环境保护基金会的气候科学家布莱恩·布马 (Brian Buma) 告诉 e360：“如果不包括进入大气中的所有排放量，那么从一开始就会受到阻碍。” “人们认识到，不考虑这些排放的时间越长，差距就会越大。”

reflection.en: The prophet Paul speaks of all creation groaning in labor pains, awaiting its ultimate redemption. This news highlights how our planet's natural systems are indeed suffering under the strain of human activity, releasing emissions that worsen the crisis. It calls us to recognize the interconnectedness of all things and our responsibility to care for the...
reflection.zh: 使徒保罗说，万物都在一同劳苦叹息，直到如今，等待着终极的救赎。这则新闻揭示了我们星球的自然系统确实承受着人类活动的重压而痛苦，释放出加剧危机的排放物。这提醒我们认识到万物相互关联，以及我们有责任照管雅伟曾宣告为“甚好”的地球。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: UK chancellor urged to remove ‘hidden taxes’ from energy bills
title.zh: 英国财政大臣受促取消能源账单中的“隐形税”

These 'hidden taxes' account for about 10% of bills, and signatories argue that shifting these costs to the government would prevent business...

In a letter to the chancellor the signatories – including Energy UK, business trade body the CBI, End Fuel Poverty and Age UK – called for levies amounting to 10% of energy bills that fund policies to be paid for by the government. John Healey is to present his first budget on 28 October. Continue reading...
body.zh: 企业、慈善机构和其他团体签署信函，呼吁政府缴纳税款 包括大企业和慈善机构在内的 120 多个组织呼吁取消能源账单中添加的“隐性税”，以帮助降低消费者成本并防止企业倒闭。在给财政大臣的一封信中，签署方——包括英国能源署、商业贸易机构英国工业联合会、结束燃料贫困和英国老龄化组织——呼吁征收相当于政府支付政策资金的能源账单 10% 的税。约翰·希利 (John Healey) 将于 10 月 28 日提交他的第一份预算。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The call from 120 organizations reminds us that economic policy is not merely a matter of spreadsheets, but a moral concern for the well-being of the community. When costs threaten to push the elderly into cold homes or force local businesses to close, the mandate for leaders to 'do justice and righteousness' becomes urgent. We pray for wisdom for those...
reflection.zh: 120 家组织的呼吁提醒我们，经济政策不仅仅是电子表格上的数字，更是关乎社区福祉的道德议题。当成本负担威胁到老年人的取暖，或迫使本地企业倒闭时，领导者“施行公平和公义”的使命就变得迫在眉睫。我们为正在制定预算的官员祈祷，愿他们拥有智慧，按照雅伟对掌权者的要求，在行政考量中优先顾及弱势群体的需求。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: A bee’s-eye view: art installation beside the Thames celebrates crucial pollinators
title.zh: 蜜蜂的视角：泰晤士河畔的艺术装置致敬关键传粉者

summary.en: An art installation called the Pollenarium, designed to resemble a pollen grain with an interior mimicking an insect's compound eye, has been erected on the banks of the Thames in east London. Artist Luke Jerram hopes the installation will entertain visitors while raising awareness about the significant decline in...
summary.zh: 一个名为“花粉仓”（Pollenarium）的艺术装置近日在伦敦东部的泰晤士河畔落成。该装置外观酷似一个花粉粒，内部则模仿昆虫的复眼。艺术家卢克·杰拉姆希望这个装置在娱乐公众的同时，也能提高人们对全球传粉者数量急剧减少的警惕。

body.en:
Steven Morris Fri 11 Sep 2026 08.32 EDT Last modified on Fri 11 Sep 2026 09.32 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google From the outside, it looks a little like something out of the Teletubbies.

In fact, the new installation by the Bristol artist Luke Jerram represents a grain of pollen, and the inside represents an insect’s compound eye.

Jerram wants the Pollenarium, which appeared on the banks of the Thames in east London this week, to entertain but also draw attention to the alarming rate pollinators at which are vanishing from the world.

“I hope it will make people think about how we need to protect pollinators,” Jerram said. “There has been a massive drop in insect numbers. Flying insects in the UK have declined by 60% in 20 years, which is mad.”

He said he was concerned that UK farmers still used some neonicotinoid pesticides . “A minuscule trace can disrupt a bee’s ability to navigate and reproduce , with long-lasting consequences for their survival.”

Best known for touring large scale sculptures of the moon, the sun and Earth, for this new piece Jerram scaled up a microscopic grain of pollen to the size of a small building. It is made of brightly coloured nylon inflated into a 6m metre high dome.

“When we had a test inflation in the car park at Paintworks [where his Bristol studio is based], people streamed out of offices to see what was going on,” Jerram said.

Inside the structure, there are more than 100 lenses, each acting as a camera obscura to create a “mosaic” of the world outside. The idea is to give an idea of how an insect might perceive the world through a compound eye. “I’ve created Pollenarium to be a bit like going inside a bee’s head,” he said.

Pollenarium, which was commissioned by Creative Barking and Dagenham , can be seen on Saturday at the Emerge East festival at Barking Riverside . It is free to visit from 11am.

It will be making an appearance at the University of Bristol after its east London debut, before embarking on a tour of the UK, accompanied by a programme of activities and workshops.
body.zh: Steven Morris 周五 2026 年 9 月 11 日 08.32 EDT 最后修改时间 周五 11 Sep 2026 09.32 EDT 分享 更喜欢 Google 上的卫报 从外面看，它看起来有点像天线宝宝中的东西。 事实上，布里斯托尔艺术家 Luke Jerram 的新装置代表了一粒花粉，其内部代表昆虫的复眼。 杰拉姆希望本周在伦敦东部泰晤士河畔出现的花粉馆能够为人们带来娱乐，同时也能引起人们对传粉媒介正在以惊人的速度从世界上消失的关注。 “我希望这能让人们思考我们需要如何保护传粉媒介，”杰拉姆说。 “昆虫数量大幅下降。英国的飞虫在 20 年内减少了 60%，这太疯狂了。” 他说，他担心英国农民仍在使用一些新烟碱类杀虫剂。 “微小的痕迹可能会破坏蜜蜂的导航和繁殖能力，对其生存造成长期影响。” 杰拉姆 (Jerram) 因巡演大型月球、太阳和地球雕塑而闻名，在这件新作品中，杰拉姆 (Jerram) 将微小的花粉颗粒放大到了一座小建筑物的大小。它由色彩鲜艳的尼龙制成，充气成 6m 米高的圆顶。 “当我们在 Paintworks（他的布里斯托尔工作室所在地）的停车场进行充气测试时，人们纷纷走出办公室，看看发生了什么，”杰拉姆说。 结构内部有 100 多个镜头，每个镜头都充当暗箱，创造出外部世界的“马赛克”。这个想法是为了让人们了解昆虫如何通过复眼感知世界。 “我创造的 Pollenarium 有点像进入蜜蜂的头部，”他说。 由 Creative Barking 和 Dagenham 委托制作的 Pollenarium 将于周六在 Barking Riverside 的 Emerge East 音乐节上亮相。 It is free to visit from 11am. 在伦敦东部首次亮相后，它将在布里斯托大学亮相，然后开始英国巡演，并举办一系列活动和研讨会。

reflection.en: Luke Jerram's Pollenarium invites us to see the world through the multifaceted eyes of insects, revealing the intricate beauty of creation. As we marvel at this perspective, we are reminded of the profound wisdom and power inherent in the natural world, which speaks of its Creator. The installation serves as a poignant call to protect these vital...
reflection.zh: 卢克·杰拉姆的“花粉仓”邀请我们透过昆虫的复眼去看世界，揭示了造物之精妙之美。当我们惊叹于这种视角时，我们被提醒到自然界蕴含着创造者的深邃智慧和大能。这个装置也成为一个令人动容的呼吁，促使我们保护这些至关重要的传粉者，认识到它们在生命微妙平衡中的关键作用。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: One in nine migratory birds threatened with extinction, global report says
title.zh: 全球报告称，九分之一的迁徙鸟类面临灭绝威胁

summary.en: A global report indicates that one in nine migratory birds are threatened with extinction, with 45% of species like cuckoos and turtle doves showing a decline. The slender-billed curlew was declared extinct last year, marking the first bird extinction in mainland Eurasia and Africa in recent centuries, and seven...

The migratory slender-billed curlew was officially declared extinct last year, the first global bird extinction in mainland Eurasia and Africa in recent centuries. Worldwide, seven migratory bird species have been confirmed or are suspected to have become extinct over the last 150 years. Continue reading...
body.zh: 关于北极燕鸥和斑鸠等物种减少的调查结果与肯尼亚峰会上的飞行路线承诺一起发布 根据一份全球报告，九分之一的候鸟面临灭绝威胁，杜鹃、斑鸠和北极燕鸥等候鸟的 45% 正在减少。候鸟细嘴鹬去年被正式宣布灭绝，这是近几个世纪以来欧亚大陆和非洲大陆首次出现全球鸟类灭绝。在过去 150 年里，全世界有 7 种候鸟已被确认或疑似灭绝。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The report on the alarming decline of migratory birds, including species like the Arctic tern and turtle dove, underscores the fragility of our planet's ecosystems. Yahweh's creation is filled with intricate wonders, and the wisdom displayed in the diversity of life, from the smallest bird to the vastest ocean, calls for our careful stewardship. May we...
reflection.zh: 关于北极燕鸥和斑鸠等迁徙鸟类数量惊人下降的报告，凸显了我们星球生态系统的脆弱性。雅伟的创造充满了精妙的奇迹，生命多样性中所展现的智慧，从最小的鸟类到浩瀚的海洋，都呼唤着我们审慎地管理。愿我们认识到保护这些生物及其赖以生存的栖息地的责任。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: More and more animals are moving into our homes as theirs get chopped down and dug up | First Dog on the Moon
title.zh: 随着家园被砍伐和挖掘，越来越多的动物搬进我们的家园 | 第一次狗在月球上

summary.en: The echidna in the pantry, the koala in the boudoir, the skink in the sink. All true! This cartoon illustrates the increasing overlap between wildlife habitats and human living spaces, as animals are displaced by development.
summary.zh: 橱柜里的针鼹，卧室里的考拉，水槽里的石龙子。都是真的！这幅漫画描绘了野生动物栖息地与人类生活空间日益重叠的景象，因为动物们因开发而被驱赶。

reflection.en: As human development encroaches on natural habitats, creatures like echidnas and koalas are finding their way into our homes. This phenomenon, while disruptive, is a stark reminder of the rich biodiversity Yahweh has created and the delicate balance of ecosystems that are now under pressure. It calls us to consider our role as stewards of creation.
reflection.zh: 随着人类开发活动侵占自然栖息地，针鼹和考拉等生物正闯入我们的家园。这种现象虽然令人不安，却也鲜明地提醒我们雅伟所创造的丰富生物多样性，以及如今承受压力的脆弱生态平衡。它呼唤我们反思作为受造界管家所扮演的角色。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.

title.en: Sargassum Superbloom: Seaweed Scourge or Ecological Boon?
title.zh: 马尾藻超量繁殖：海藻灾害还是生态福音？

summary.en: A massive bloom of sargassum seaweed, stretching from West Africa to the Gulf of Mexico, is inundating beaches and harming coastal wildlife. However, scientists have found that this floating algae supports a diverse array of marine life, leading some to advocate for its protection.
summary.zh: 从西非一直延伸到墨西哥湾的大规模马尾藻繁殖，正淹没海滩并危害沿海野生动物。然而，科学家发现这种漂浮的海藻支撑着各种各样的海洋生物，这使得一些人开始呼吁保护它。

body.en:
Stretching from West Africa to the Gulf of Mexico, a massive bloom of sargassum seaweed is swamping beaches and killing coastal wildlife. But scientists have discovered the floating algae also shelters a vast array of ocean creatures, and some are now calling for its protection.

Many of America’s favorite beaches in Florida and the Caribbean have been piled high with foul-smelling seaweed again this summer, often in record amounts. What disappointed tourists may not know is that the inundations, which also smother coral reefs, mangroves, and seagrasses, are just the most visible sign of a vast new marine ecosystem — an expanse of floating sargassum that since 2011 has seemingly come from nowhere to spread in a 5,500-mile-long belt from Mexico to West Africa and Florida to Brazil.

The dense mats of offshore weed grow up to 20 feet thick, and this summer reached a record weight of 38 million metric tons — more than the total weight of all Americans.

The seaweed scourge is wrecking coastal economies in countries heavily dependent on tourism and fishing. The coastlines of 30 countries across the Caribbean and beyond are being visited by the brown mats piling up on beaches, where the weed decomposes, releasing gases such as hydrogen sulfide, with its distinctive rotten-egg smell, and ammonia, which trigger asthma attacks and exacerbate other respiratory conditions. Thousands of victims have been reported by doctors in the Caribbean, especially among workers clearing beaches.

The weed also blocks water intakes and prevents fishers from taking their boats to sea, as well as clogging their nets, engines, and propellers. It has caused mass deaths of marine life on coastlines, while preventing sea turtles from laying their eggs on beaches and blocking hatchlings trying to return to the ocean. The weed also accumulates heavy metals such as arsenic, which leaches out as the weed decomposes on land and can poison water supplies.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

But, while acknowledging its onshore harms, some researchers are now recognizing the Great Atlantic Sargassum Belt as a significant new habitat for marine life in the open ocean, and a valuable carbon sink for the planet. According to Jonathan Jung, a marine ecologist at the Max Planck Institute for Chemistry in Mainz, Germany, the weed and its growing army of inhabitants now form “the largest interconnected floating biome on Earth.”

Sargassum seaweed in the Atlantic was once mostly confined to the Sargasso Sea, an area of sluggish waters off Bermuda largely cut off from the rest of the ocean by rotating ocean currents. It has been well-known to mariners since Christopher Columbus reported sailing through “so much grass that it looked like the...
body.zh: 从西非一直延伸到墨西哥湾，大量的马尾藻海藻正在淹没海滩并杀死沿海野生动物。但科学家发现，这些漂浮的藻类也为大量海洋生物提供了庇护，一些海洋生物现在呼吁保护它们。 今年夏天，美国佛罗里达州和加勒比海地区许多最受欢迎的海滩再次堆满了恶臭的海藻，数量往往达到创纪录的水平。失望的游客可能不知道的是，洪水也淹没了珊瑚礁、红树林和海草，而这只是一个巨大的新海洋生态系统最明显的标志——自 2011 年以来，一大片漂浮的马尾藻似乎不知从何而来，在从墨西哥到西非、从佛罗里达到巴西的 5,500 英里长的带上蔓延。 近海杂草丛生，厚度可达 20 英尺，今年夏天的重量达到创纪录的 3800 万吨——超过了所有美国人的总重量。 海藻祸害正在破坏严重依赖旅游业和渔业的国家的沿海经济。加勒比海及其他地区30个国家的海岸线正被堆积在海滩上的棕色垫子所覆盖，这些杂草在海滩上分解，释放出硫化氢等气体，具有独特的臭鸡蛋味，还有氨气，会引发哮喘发作并加剧其他呼吸道疾病。加勒比地区的医生报告了数千人的受害者，特别是清理海滩的工人。 这种杂草还会阻塞进水口，阻止渔民将船出海，并堵塞渔网、发动机和螺旋桨。它导致海岸线海洋生物大量死亡，同时阻止海龟在海滩上产卵，并阻止试图返回海洋的幼龟。这种杂草还会积累砷等重金属，当杂草在陆地上分解时，砷会渗出，污染水源。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 但是，在承认其陆上危害的同时，一些研究人员现在认识到大大西洋马尾藻带是公海海洋生物的重要新栖息地，也是地球宝贵的碳汇。德国美因茨马克斯·普朗克化学研究所的海洋生态学家乔纳森·荣格表示，这种杂草及其不断增长的居民大军现在形成了“地球上最大的相互关联的漂浮生物群落”。 大西洋中的马尾藻海藻曾经主要局限于马尾藻海，这是百慕大附近的一个缓慢水域，由于旋转洋流，基本上与海洋其他部分隔绝。自从克里斯托弗·哥伦布报道航行穿过“如此多的草，看起来就像……”以来，它就为水手们所熟知。

reflection.en: The vast expanse of sargassum seaweed, initially seen as a scourge, is revealing itself as a complex ecosystem teeming with life. This reminds us that even in what appears problematic, Yahweh's intricate design is at work, with creation itself bearing witness to His wisdom and power. As Romans 1:20 says, His invisible attributes are clearly perceived, being...
reflection.zh: 最初被视为灾难的马尾藻大片海藻，正逐渐显露出其作为复杂生态系统的面貌，其中充满了生命。这提醒我们，即使在看似有问题的事物中，雅伟精妙的设计也在运作，而祂的创造本身就见证了祂的智慧与大能。正如罗马书1:20所说，祂的永恒大能和神性，自从创造世界以来，藉着所造之物就可以晓得。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: How Two Oscar Winners Are Charting New Paths for Indian Cinema at TIFF with ‘Dorothy’ and ‘Termite’
title.zh: 两位奥斯卡获奖者如何以《桃乐茜》和《白蚁》为 TIFF 印度电影开辟新道路

summary.en: At TIFF, director Karthik Subbaraj and producer Guneet Monga Kapoor discuss the unique qualities of their large-scale Tamil gangster film 'Dorothy.' Meanwhile, Shaunak Sen talks about 'Termite,' his first venture into directing fiction, and a documentary feature he is co-producing with Joaquin Phoenix.
summary.zh: 在多伦多国际电影节（TIFF）上，《桃乐茜》的导演 Karthik Subbaraj 和制片人 Guneet Monga Kapoor 揭示了这部大制作的泰米尔黑帮片为何如此特别。同时，Shaunak Sen 讨论了他的首部虚构作品《白蚁》，以及他与 Joaquin Phoenix 联合制作的一部纪录长片。

body.en:

You might remember the 2023 Academy Awards for the ascendance of “Everything Everywhere All At Once.” But it was also a historic year for Indian cinema. The stateside craze over “RRR,” the Telugu-language Indian action bonanza, reached a crescendo when it danced its way to the Oscar for Best Original Song. Another winner that evening was producer Guneet Monga Kapoor, nabbing the Oscar for Documentary Short for “ The Elephant Whisperers .” Shaunak Sen ’s “ All That Breathes ” was also nominated for Documentary Feature after winning top prizes at Sundance and Cannes. The South Asian community had plenty to cheer about that night. Related Stories ‘Burgundy’ Review: A Warm, Witty Winemaking Vibe Documentary You’ll Want to Pair with a Glass of Red One of the Year’s Best Film Books Celebrates the Unsung Artists That Turned ‘The Women’ Into a Classic

As the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival rolls around, the community again has much to be excited about, with nearly a dozen films from the subcontinent across the lineup. Sen and Monga Kapoor will meet in Toronto again, each celebrating a career milestone with their premieres on Friday.

“Termite,” a poetic short about a Delhi exterminator whose roommate gets an unexpected marriage proposal, is Sen’s first film as a director after “All That Breathes,” and his fiction debut. Monga Kapoor unveils “Dorothy,” a gangster western directed by Karthik Subbaraj, making it the first feature from the renowned Tamil director to premiere at a major festival. His previous nine, including “Mercury” and “Jigarthanda,” had direct theatrical releases. Significantly, “Dorothy” is Monga Kapoor’s first film after India’s leading entertainment company, Jio Studios (the content arm of Reliance Industries), acquired a majority stake in her and Achin Jain’s storied production company, Sikhya Entertainment, earlier this year.

“Dorothy” and “Termite” could not be more different, and their paths to TIFF illustrate the fascinating contrasts in creative collaborations, financing landscapes, and visions behind the slates built by Sikhya as a studio and KiteRabbit, the production company Sen and his producing partner Aman Mann started with “All That Breathes.” IndieWire caught up with Sen, Monga Kapoor, and Subbaraj the week before TIFF, as...

reflection.en: The dedication of filmmakers like Karthik Subbaraj and Shaunak Sen to their craft, pushing the boundaries of Indian cinema, embodies the pursuit of knowledge and understanding. Their work at festivals like TIFF showcases a commitment to learning and innovation, mirroring the wisdom found in seeking understanding.
reflection.zh: Karthik Subbaraj 和 Shaunak Sen 等电影制作人对其技艺的投入，以及他们拓展印度电影的边界，体现了对知识和理解的追求。他们在多伦多国际电影节等电影节上的工作，展现了对学习和创新的承诺，这与寻求理解的智慧相呼应。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: ‘Burgundy’ Review: A Warm, Witty Winemaking Vibe Documentary You’ll Want to Pair with a Glass of Red
title.zh: 《勃艮第》影评：一部您想配一杯红酒享用的温馨、诙谐的酿酒氛围纪录片

summary.en: Venice: But you don't need to be wine-drunk to savor the "The Truffle Hunters" directors Michael Dweck and Gregory Kershaw's airy immersion into ancient French tradition.
summary.zh: 威尼斯：但您不必酩酊大醉也能品味到《松露猎人》导演迈克尔·德维克和格雷戈里·克肖尔所带来的对古老法国传统的轻松沉浸。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

American documentary directors Michael Dweck and Gregory Kershaw have made delicately poetic ethnographies their filmmaking raison d’être . From the black-and-white Argentine rodeo culture portrait “ Gaucho Gaucho ” to trailing dogs chasing the elusive Alba truffle in Northern Italy in “ The Truffle Hunters ,” the filmmakers also serve as cinematographers on all their work. That means that while the requisites of making a vérité documentary demand a certain distance, there’s also a degree of lyrical blocking and framing suggestive of fiction storytellers.

Their latest doc, the light-bodied “ Burgundy ,” is even more of a vibe movie than their previous efforts, an airy, featherweight but surprisingly sweet collection of moments spent with a winemaking dynasty in the titular French region during a pivotal season. And a possible change of hands. Dweck and Kershaw spent two years embedded with the sommeliers, laborers, and other inhabitants of the region’s most celebrated vineyards to capture a sense of ancient tradition dating back to the Romans. The film ‘s shuffle among the ensemble — including 80-something wine estate mogul Bertrand, his wanderlusting grandson Melchior, trusted worker Enzo, and the budding sommelier named Céleste whom Enzo is falling for — can be dizzying. Related Stories One of the Year’s Best Film Books Celebrates the Unsung Artists That Turned ‘The Women’ Into a Classic Korean Star Jeon Do-yeon’s Outstanding ‘Possible Love’ Performance Could Earn Venice’s Best Actress Prize — or Lee Chang-dong the Golden Lion

Some characters, like the handsome and erudite-beyond-his-years Enzo, merit more screen time than others. Also a great onscreen character is the wine critic Guillaume who, when not applying his faculties to the tannic particulars of a glass, is rehashing a recent split-up on the psychoanalytic couch. There’s also a charmingly type-A maître d’ who probably knows where the bodies are buried, if there are any, in these here provinces.

Winemaking in a quaint country town is not without its rigid class hierarchies dating back to 160 years, for example, on the property Bertrand oversees after being handed it across several generations. He’s ready to make Melchior his successor, but Bertrand’s seasoned joie de vivre for wine production isn’t exactly reciprocated by his grandson....
